findings.where: Right side of image, where the scarf tail meets the staff
findings.evidence: The long red scarf tail flows down and melts directly into the top of the wooden staff with no boundary, making the staff appear to grow out of the fabric.
The figure is cropped at the waist with no legs or feet shown, but the spec requires a full-body character.

The raised open palm (thumb on the medial side, i.e., left-hand anatomy) is attached to the arm on the character's right side, and the staff is held on the character's left, swapping the spec's left-hand-raised / right-hand-on-staff assignment.
